messages:
lauren: quick heads-up — PR #4321 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321) has a couple of broken anchors in the '429 & timeouts' runbook and the SDK snippet example in /snippets/node/retries.md is out of date. can someone own a quick sweep?

mike: I can take the anchors. which ones are broken?

lauren: thanks! the runbook links from 'Fallback ordering' -> 'Canary fallback' and from the 'Client retries' section to the SDK snippet both 404. sample anchors: #canary-fallback, #client-retries. also the code block in node snippet uses old fetch() wrapper.

anya: pinging @sam — you updated the node snippet in last release, right?

sam: yup. I changed the Node SDK retry API last week. I'll push a minimal compat snippet in a follow-up. ETA ~2 hours :zap: 

docsbot: autolink-check: 2 broken anchors detected in docs/runbooks/429-timeouts.md — CI job docs-link-checker failed (see https://ci.internal/reports/9876)

mike: I found the two anchors. they moved under a combined 'Fallback strategies' heading. I'll add markdown anchor aliases and update the cross-doc links. plan: use heading IDs like 'Canary fallback {#canary-fallback}'. OK?

lauren: prefer the markdown-style heading ids instead of raw HTML. that keeps the repo portable.

mike: good call. will push a tiny PR with aliases + TOC fix. will also add a redirect link in the runbook header for older references.

sam: working on the node snippet. current patch in branch sam/sdk-compat-4321. snippet diff (draft):
```js
// legacy usage
await client.retry.generate(prompt, { maxRetries: 2 });

// new usage
await client.request.generate({ prompt, retries: { maxAttempts: 3 } });
```
I'll include both examples and a short migration note.

anya: QA checklist for this sweep: 1) link-checker passes 2) snippets run in playground CI 3) add a changelog note: "SDK: node retry API usage (compat examples)" — I'll take changelog.

lauren: owners then: mike -> anchor aliases + cross-doc links; sam -> node snippet updates in PR 4321 + follow-up compat PR; anya -> changelog + verify playground CI; lauren -> merge once CI green.

mike: started branch and pushed to github.com/redwood-inference/docs@mike/anchor-aliases-4321. opened a tiny PR and requested review from @lauren and @anya.

sam: pushed snippet updates to sam/sdk-compat-4321 and added a PR comment linking to mike's anchor PR. left a TODO to include a small mapping table for migrating old client.retry.* -> client.request.*.

anya: re-ran link-checker locally after mike's branch — 0 failures so far. will re-run after sam's snippet PR merges and before we merge the runbook PR.

lauren: timeline: target merge EOD today if CI passes; otherwise move to Monday morning. :thumbsup:

mike: any risk of external links or docs referencing old anchors? the aliases should avoid breaking existing bookmarks.

sam: I'll keep the legacy snippet visible in a compat fenced block for 30 days and add a deprecation note.

docsbot: notify: PR 4321 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321) updated with labels: docs, urgent, 429-runbook. CI status: pending (docs-link-checker, snippets-playground).

lauren: thanks all — I'll watch the PRs and merge when CI is green. anyone else need to add anything?

mike: nope, good to go.

sam: nothing else from me.

anya: all set — I'll handle the release note during deploy.
